post.text:
For the first time in history, the value of the British Pound Sterling is worth less than two United States Dollars. 

At 2:39 PM London time, the value of the Pound falls to £1.975/$1 USD. https://t.co/QKTDoaUs8w
post.author_description: Live-posting as a reporter embedded in history. Curated by @MannyMarotta. Companion to @100YearsAgoLive, @25YearsAgoLive, and @250YearsAgoLive. DM for business.

description.description: The obverse side of a British decimal coin from 1976, featuring the second portrait of Queen Elizabeth II by Arnold Machin. The profile shows the Queen facing right, wearing the Girls of Great Britain and Ireland Tiara. The bronze-colored coin has a beaded border.

The image shows both sides of a 1976 United States one-cent coin (penny). The left side is the obverse, featuring the profile of Abraham Lincoln facing right, while the right side is the reverse, showing the Lincoln Memorial.
description.ocrText: IN GOD WE TRUST LIBERTY 1976 UNITED STATES OF AMERICA E PLURIBUS UNUM ONE CENT
